changes.why: 'Außendienst' means field sales/customer visits in German; police, fire, rescue, army, pilots are 'im Einsatz' - natural and covers the scope
'Geräte' is generic and reads as household appliances (the sibling group 2401: fridge, toaster, kettle); 'Elektronik' names phones, computers, headphones, cameras and matches sk/cz
'Zem' means the planet/ground/soil (and is the natural name of the parent 'Earth'); it does not read as fields, meadows, forests, deserts. 'Krajina' would be too close to 208 'Krajiny', so 'Príroda'
